Administrative Services

Office of The Vice-Chancellor

The Office of the Vice-Chancellor provides executive leadership, strategic vision, and academic governance at BUBT.

Room: 206-207, Floor: 1, Building: 1, BUBT Main Campus

About the Office

The Office of the Vice Chancellor of Bangladesh University of Business and Technology (BUBT) serves as the central executive authority of the university. It provides strategic leadership, academic direction, and administrative oversight to ensure the institution’s vision, mission, and goals are effectively implemented. The office coordinates with academic departments, administrative units, statutory bodies, and external stakeholders to maintain academic excellence, quality assurance, research development, and institutional governance. Through policy guidance, decision-making, and supervision, the Vice Chancellor’s Office plays a vital role in upholding the standards, reputation, and continuous growth of BUBT.

Services of Our Office

Leadership in academic and administrative matters

Provides overall leadership and direction in academic, administrative, and institutional affairs of the university.

Oversight of institutional policies and quality assurance

Ensures effective implementation of university policies while maintaining academic standards and quality assurance.

Representation of BUBT in external academic and policy-making bodies

Represents BUBT in national and international academic forums, regulatory bodies, and policy-making institutions.

Strategic planning and development coordination

Leads strategic planning initiatives and coordinates development activities to achieve the university’s long-term goals.

Crisis Management & Institutional Decision-Making

Provides leadership during critical situations and ensures timely and effective decision-making for institutional stability.

Approval & Authorization Services

Approves major academic, administrative, and financial decisions including policies, committees, appointments, and institutional initiatives.
